title: "Hand-drawn slides"
subtitle: "made with scratchy"
author: "Your name"
format:
  excalidraw-revealjs:
    excalidraw:
      paper: dots
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(scratchy)
cars <- ggplot(mpg, aes(class)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#a5d8ff") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "cars")
```

## Charts that look drawn by hand

```{r}
sketch(cars, background = FALSE)
```

## Point things out

```{r}
as_excalidraw(cars, width = 860, height = 480) |>
  exc_mark(x = "suv", y = c(0, 62), type = "box") |>
  exc_note("SUVs win!", x = "midsize", y = 52, to = c("suv", 50)) |>
  exc_callout("only 5 of these", x = "2seater", y = 5, dx = 30, dy = -70) |>
  plot(background = FALSE)
```

## Highlight words, one click at a time

- Data can be [beautiful]{.rn-highlight}
- Charts can be [playful]{.rn-circle .fragment}
- Messages should be [clear]{.rn-underline .fragment}
- Jargon is [never needed]{.rn-strike .fragment}

## Notes and boxes

[Remember to smile]{.sticky-note} [and breathe]{.sticky-note .blue}

::: {.sketch-box data-fill="#e7f5ff"}
Anything inside a `.sketch-box` gets a hand-drawn border (and an optional
hachure fill).
:::

## Diagrams

```{r}
# Mermaid text becomes editable Excalidraw shapes (this needs Chrome); a saved
# copy is used when Chrome isn't available.
flow <- tryCatch(
  exc_mermaid("flowchart LR\n  A[Data] --> B[Sketch it] --> C[Share]\n  B --> D((Smile))"),
  error = function(e) read_excalidraw(system.file("templates", "flow.excalidraw", package = "scratchy"))
)
plot(flow, background = FALSE)
```

## Change the whole look

```{r}
sketch(ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = drv)) + geom_point(size = 3) +
         scale_colour_excalidraw(), preset = "chalkboard")
```
